name: Companion: Beast of the Land
desc: Land companion (cat, wolf, etc.). AC 13 + your Wisdom modifier, Hit Points 5 + 5 × your Ranger level, Speed 40 feet, Climb 40 feet. Beast's Strike: your spell attack modifier, reach 5 feet, 1d8 + 2 + your Wisdom modifier; after a 20-foot charge, +1d6 and a Large or smaller target is knocked Prone.
